proves.claim: serving refuses a missing person-needs reader or refusal formatter before consuming any protocol input.

mcp.serve.refuses-missing-composition.why: A cell composed without its native readers must fail loudly, not serve half-wired.

proves.claim: initialize answers the requested protocol version or the first supported, names the seat, and ignores notifications.

mcp.protocol.initialize-handshake.why: Clients negotiate the protocol on the first message; a wrong answer breaks every session.

proves.claim: a checkout with no agent is reported on the log and the server still serves.

mcp.serve.no-agent-still-serves.why: A fresh checkout must not make the tool server unusable.

proves.claim: every tool lists a closed input schema and none offers a person move.

mcp.tools.closed-schemas-no-person-move.why: Closed schemas keep calls checkable and keep the person-only moves out of agent reach.

proves.claim: malformed lines, bad requests and unknown methods get JSON-RPC errors in order.

mcp.protocol.jsonrpc-errors-in-order.why: A client must be able to match every reply to its request even after bad input.

proves.claim: a person move is refused under any spelling before arguments are read or the CLI runs.

mcp.guard.refuses-person-move-any-spelli.why: The person-only boundary must hold however the tool name is spelled.

proves.claim: unknown, missing, mistyped and out-of-enum arguments are refused.

mcp.tools.validates-arguments.why: Bad arguments must stop at the schema, not reach the CLI.

proves.claim: each loop move runs as the CLI argv it mirrors, flags as --name=value and positionals after --.

mcp.tools.mirrors-cli-argv.why: The tool and the CLI must be one behaviour, never two.

proves.claim: a CLI refusal comes back as a tool result flagged isError with the CLI document intact.

mcp.tools.refusal-is-error-result.why: Agents read the refusal code and next step exactly as the CLI printed them.

proves.claim: shout runs as the seat agent and an idea becomes a coordinator shout of kind idea.

mcp.tools.shout-and-idea-capture.why: Messages must carry the sender seat and the right kind.

proves.claim: board_status joins status, list and the shared person-needs list and stops at the first refusal.

mcp.tools.board-status-joins.why: One call must give the whole picture without hiding a refusal.

proves.claim: code-map tools use the native reader, never the CLI, and are refused without one.

mcp.tools.codemap-native-reader-only.why: Code-map reads must stay off the CLI path and fail clearly when unwired.

proves.claim: a failing CLI command becomes an internal error naming the cause.

mcp.tools.cli-failure-internal-error.why: A crash must be diagnosable from the reply.

proves.claim: messages are served one at a time in arrival order even when an earlier tool is slow.

mcp.serve.messages-in-arrival-order.why: Reordered replies would corrupt agent state.

proves.claim: creating a cloud board refuses with the H15 reason while H29 is unapproved and runs no command.

mcp.tools.cloud-board-refused-h29.why: The cloud board stays closed until the person approves it.

proves.claim: Every titled mcp test has a stable ID and one complete registry record.

mcp.registry.complete.why: An mcp test without a record left the strict registry red.
